visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short dark hair, wearing a white Dodgers baseball jersey and sunglasses perched on her head, stands in a modern white kitchen. She gestures toward the camera with an excited expression. (2) She places a cardboard shipping box from 'momo' on the white counter and uses a utility knife to slice it open. She pulls out a grey jar opener tool wrapped in plastic. (3) She holds the jar opener up to her face, smiling broadly. A small circular overlay shows a still image of her. (4) She attempts to use the tool on a large green pickle jar placed on a grey circular mat. Her hands struggle to grip and turn the device initially. (5) A second woman in a blue jersey enters the frame, and they both huddle over a small instruction manual to figure out how to use the device. (6) The first woman successfully uses the tool to pop the seal of the jar, looking surprised as the lid comes off easily. (7) She then demonstrates the tool on a tall yellow wine bottle, successfully removing the cap. (8) Finally, she drinks from a water bottle while engaging in a conversation with someone off-camera, looking satisfied with the product.
